labels.name: Perimysium
labels.function: Sheath around a bundle of fibers; inflamed around vessels in DM

labels.name: Endomysium
labels.function: Thin sheath around each fiber; site of PM inflammation

labels.name: Myocyte
labels.function: Contractile cell; releases CK and aldolase when damaged

labels.name: CD8+ cytotoxic T cells
labels.function: Invade non-necrotic fibers in polymyositis (and IBM)

labels.name: Perimysial blood vessel
labels.function: Complement-mediated injury makes bundle-edge fibers ischemic

labels.name: Perifascicular atrophy
labels.function: Shrunken fibers at bundle edges; diagnostic of dermatomyositis

labels.name: Rimmed vacuole
labels.function: Sarcoplasmic inclusion seen only in inclusion body myositis

labels.name: Amyloid deposit
labels.function: Congo red-positive protein aggregate in IBM fibers

labels.name: Heliotrope rash
labels.function: Lilac eruption on the upper eyelids; pathognomonic of DM

labels.name: Malar rash
labels.function: Central facial erythema that also crosses the nasolabial fold

labels.name: Gottron papules
labels.function: Scaly violaceous papules over the MCP, PIP and DIP joints

labels.name: Oropharyngeal muscles
labels.function: Weakness causes dysphagia and aspiration risk

labels.name: Shoulder girdle muscles
labels.function: Symmetric proximal weakness of PM and DM; hard to lift overhead

labels.name: Lungs
labels.function: Interstitial disease is a systemic manifestation

labels.name: Finger flexors
labels.function: Distal arm weakness typical of inclusion body myositis

labels.name: Quadriceps
labels.function: Early, often asymmetric IBM target; falls, trouble rising
